4-Bedroom Luxury Villa in Caya 1, Arabian Ranches 3

Experience refined living in this stunning 4-bedroom villa located in Caya 1, Arabian Ranches 3. With a generous built-up area of 4,935 sq. ft., this home offers a perfect blend of space, comfort, and modern design, featuring 4 bathrooms and thoughtfully planned interiors.

The villa boasts expansive living and dining areas, a contemporary kitchen with high-quality finishes, and spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes. Floor-to-ceiling windows invite abundant natural light and enhance the home’s bright and airy ambiance. The layout is ideal for family living and entertaining.
